items.title: Scent Confidence and Premium Gifting discovery
items.name: Scent Confidence and Premium Gifting discovery
items.summary: Discovery work is testing whether guided scent, occasion, review, and gift builder changes increase confidence without making the purchase journey too long.
items.opportunity: Clarify whether choice hesitation is driven more by sensory uncertainty, weak gift fit, missing delivery clarity, or insufficient product claims.

linkedInitiatives.description: Focused investment to improve scent-led guided discovery, gift configuration, product confidence, and premium basket composition.

riskFocus.question: Will guided scent and gifting flows materially increase confidence and conversion?
riskFocus.hypothesis: Customers convert more often when scent, recipient, occasion, and promise constraints are handled before product comparison.

plannedActivities: Compare finder completion, conversion, and confidence by entry point.
Test revised scent note and occasion language on product pages.
Review gift delivery contacts and failed promise reasons.
items.decisionToMake: Decide which guided discovery and gift builder patterns become standard for priority markets in Q2.

items.title: Member Replenishment and Refill discovery
items.name: Member Replenishment and Refill discovery
items.summary: Discovery work is testing which reminders, refill explanations, and member benefits create useful routine continuity without annoying members.
items.opportunity: Clarify whether replenishment underperformance is driven more by timing, stock availability, refill compatibility confusion, or weak perceived benefits.

linkedInitiatives.description: Focused investment to improve member reorder timing, refill compatibility clarity, and consent-aware benefit personalization.

riskFocus.question: Do members reorder or refill more when reminders explain timing, compatibility, and benefits together?
riskFocus.hypothesis: Reminder acceptance improves when the product can explain why now, why this refill fits, and what member value applies.
methods: A/B test of refill explanation patterns

plannedActivities: Map depletion estimates against actual reorder timing.
Test refill compatibility copy and benefit framing.
items.decisionToMake: Decide which replenishment and refill signals graduate into the member experience in Q2.

items.title: Advisor Service and Store Execution discovery
items.name: Advisor Service and Store Execution discovery
items.summary: Discovery work is testing whether better consultation context, stock truth, and task clarity improve advisor confidence and pickup reliability.
items.opportunity: Clarify whether assisted service gaps are driven more by missing customer context, weak product knowledge, unreliable store stock, or unclear tasks.

linkedInitiatives.description: Focused investment to improve consultation note quality, advisor stock visibility, appointment handling, pickup readiness, and store task execution.

riskFocus.question: Can advisors use customer context and stock information fast enough during real store conversations?
riskFocus.hypothesis: Advisor adoption increases when customer context, recommendations, and stock recovery are visible in one tablet workflow.

plannedActivities: Observe advisor consultations in pilot stores.
Review failed pickup and endless-aisle cases.
Test revised consultation note and saved recommendation flow.
items.decisionToMake: Decide which advisor tablet workflows and store stock controls should be rolled out first.

items.title: Launch and Claims Governance discovery
items.name: Launch and Claims Governance discovery
items.summary: Discovery work is testing where product launch and claim workflows create customer-facing defects or late store readiness.
items.opportunity: Clarify whether launch defects are caused by product data setup, claim approval ambiguity, supplier evidence gaps, or weak store task definitions.

linkedInitiatives.description: Focused investment to improve product data quality, claim approval traceability, supplier evidence, and cross-market launch readiness.

riskFocus.question: Can launch, product data, claims, sourcing evidence, and store tasks be governed as one auditable workflow?
riskFocus.hypothesis: Defects fall when launch readiness is blocked until product setup, claim approvals, and store tasks share one visible state.

plannedActivities: Review recent collection launches and claim corrections.
Map product data, formula, supplier, and compliance handoffs.
Prototype a launch readiness dashboard for store and commerce teams.
items.decisionToMake: Decide which readiness checks should become mandatory launch gates in Q2.
